Phase One

Emotional Wellness Apparel

Healing looks good on you.

Since 2019, more than 12 million adults have started therapy. Personal work isn’t niche anymore; it’s culture. People are doing real work — naming their trauma, setting boundaries, practicing self-care — but they have no tangible way to show their progress.

DYWork (Do Your Work) is the first retail brand to make those journeys visible. Our merchandise gives people a way to see, share, and wear their story, proving the work they’re doing on themselves actually matters. It’s more than clothing. It’s a uniform for a deeper movement and a way to signal, to yourself and others, “I’m doing the work too.”

Customer Impact
Run It Up — Dallas, TX

At Run It Up’s two-year anniversary — the largest Black wellness run club in Dallas — a customer read the quote, “I Saved Myself So My Loved Ones Wouldn’t Have To.”™ He purchased the shirt for himself and his girlfriend, shared that both of his parents battled addiction, and said he understood the message on a soul level. He cried, hugged our team, and thanked us for putting words to his experience.

Phase Two

Scientific Research

Growth is messy. It happens in everyday moments when you feel triggered. Without a clear process, it’s easy to repeat old patterns or avoid the situation altogether. The Applied Change Framework helps you interrupt that cycle and respond in alignment with who you want to be. It happens in four phases: Pause, Reflect, Select, Apply.

The Applied Change Framework
P
Pause
Slow the moment down.
R
Reflect
Understand how you feel and notice the pattern beneath it.
S
Select
Choose a response aligned with your values.
A
Apply
Carry it through, even when it’s hard.

Education & Digital Practice

The Applied Change Framework is designed to be taught, practiced, and strengthened over time. Through education and guided digital practice, individuals learn how to Pause, Reflect, Select, and Apply in real-life situations.

Phase Four

Institutional Certification

Institutional Certification equips schools, nonprofits, and clinicians to teach and implement the framework with integrity. It includes formal training and clear standards for delivery so the method stays consistent.
